children: Ernexa Therapeutics reported no revenue in the third quarter, as in the prior-year period. Net loss widened as research and development expenses rose, primarily due to higher ERNA-101 study fees and increased research and development headcount; improved interest income partly offset the increase.
² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per common share - basic and diluted”.
: Third-quarter research and development expenses rose to $1.9M, primarily due to higher study fees related to ERNA-101.
: The company is prioritizing near-term capital and operational resources for ERNA-101 and expanding its oncology pipeline.
: September preclinical results showed improved clinical arthritis scores and disease severity in a collagen-induced rheumatoid arthritis model.
: The company expects to complete IND-enabling studies and submit an IND in 2026, followed by a Phase I investigator-sponsored trial in the first half of 2027.
